{{Quote|That Freight Queen is making ready to leave.|Leia to Han in the Lizil hive's hangar|<ref name="DNIII SW">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>}}
The '''Freight Queen''' was one of the classes of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parked in the [[Lizil (Hive)|Lizil]] [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[Lizil|hive's]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] during the [[Swarm War]] between [[the Colony]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], and the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]<ref name="DNIII SW" /> in [[36 ABY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], in disguise as [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Rysto and Syrule, respectively, were attempting to track down the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] turned [[Joiner]]s [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Zekk]], and bring them back from the front lines of the war. While looking for a spot to land in the Lizil hangar, Leia spotted a Freight Queen taking off. That left an empty space behind for another starship to land, though Han and Leia instead decided to land the ''[[Swiff]]'', a [[Dray-class transport|''Dray''-class transport]] that they had borrowed from their old friend [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], in another part of the hangar.<ref name="DNIII SW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Freight Queen appeared in ''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]'', the third and final instalment of the ''[[Star Wars: The Dark Nest Trilogy]]'' written by [[Troy Denning]] and released in [[2005]].<ref name="DNIII SW" />
